verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say it "aims to be Sentry API compatible", so tools built against Sentry's API should work. Its GitLab Error Tracking and Grafana integrations rely on that API, and the CLI authenticates with SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, so an issues/events API with token auth plausibly exists. However, GlitchTip publishes no REST API reference of its own, every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404, and the MCP issue tools are a separate interface that cannot be credited here. Missing for 10: first-party REST API documentation, explicit list/query/update issue endpoints, raw event retrieval endpoints, documented token scopes, independent or hands-on corroboration of API compatibility.
